title: Final Intensity Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the intensity equation I(theta) = 1.5 I_0 cos^2(theta) + I_0 sin^2(theta).

title: Maximum Intensity
description: Essential Criteria: The student must determine the maximum transmitted intensity as I_max = 1.75 I_0 when theta = 30 degrees.

title: Unpolarised Fraction
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the unpolarised fraction of the incident intensity as 0.60.

title: Reasoning Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student should show clear reasoning in deriving the relationship between the components of the polarized light and the unpolarized light.

title: Angle Dependency
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain that the intensity I(theta) does not depend on the fraction of unpolarized light.

title: Phase Change Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the effect of the quarter-wave plate on the polarization state of the light.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as incorrect application of the intensity equations or miscalculating the unpolarized fraction.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all intensities are expressed consistently in terms of I_0.
